readerPaths.safeNextAction: Run the platform-native check-only command and evaluate report plus exit code.
Review the complete fleet preflight before authorizing a mutation.
Determine source ownership, distribution class and current delivery authority.
Inspect lock, report, log, process result and evidence consistency before recovery.

claims.statement: Check-only inspects and fetches without pulls or package updates.
claims.proofBoundary: The option proves inspection behavior only; a drift exit remains possible.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: The public wrapper option or its side effects change.

claims.statement: The public option table defines TUI, plain, headless, preview, scripts-only, repair, optional-package, administrator, manifest and home-directory controls.
claims.proofBoundary: The table proves public spelling and summarized effects; detailed preconditions remain in the surrounding contract.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: A public Bash option, PowerShell parameter or interaction rule changes.

claims.statement: Exit codes 0, 1, 2, 3 and 130 distinguish success, drift, operational failure, repaired drift and cancellation; Linux TERM uses 143.
claims.proofBoundary: An exit code must be reconciled with the finalized report and cannot prove completion alone.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: An orchestrator, signal or repaired-drift exit mapping changes.

claims.statement: Only a clean canonical default branch with an unambiguous upstream, zero ahead commits and a purely behind state may be fast-forwarded automatically.
claims.proofBoundary: Dirty, Ahead, Diverged, Detached, Non-Default and ambiguous states remain blocking even after a successful fetch.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: Repository classification or safe-pull policy changes.

claims.statement: Temporary worktree cleanup is lease-bound and never uses a global clean, prune, reset or stash.
claims.proofBoundary: Only unambiguously owned, still-clean and Git-registered temporary worktrees are eligible for cleanup.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: Lease schema, cleanup ownership or worktree lifecycle changes.

claims.statement: Lock, log and finalized JSON report share one Run ID and are atomically reconciled with terminal status and process exit.
claims.proofBoundary: Machine-local logs support reconstruction but are not publishable evidence by themselves.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: Run identity, report finalization or evidence location changes.

claims.statement: JSONL events support live display only; EVENT_STREAM_DEGRADED permanently selects linear presentation while report and process exit remain authoritative.
claims.proofBoundary: An event stream cannot independently promote a run to success.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: Event schema, degradation behavior or completion authority changes.

claims.statement: The first Ctrl+C is forwarded exactly once; later signals start no second engine and trigger no broad cleanup.
claims.proofBoundary: Controlled cancellation still requires the finalized report and process exit to establish the outcome.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: Signal forwarding, cancellation or cleanup semantics change.

claims.statement: A required administrator operation without current authority is DEFERRED_ADMIN_REQUIRED and blocks completion with exit 1.
claims.proofBoundary: The status records the unperformed remainder and does not grant or emulate administrator rights.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: Administrator authority or deferred-result mapping changes.

claims.statement: The Home synchronization manifest separates homeRuntime, sourceOnly and machineLocal content.
claims.proofBoundary: The manifest defines membership; it does not itself authorize writing or publication.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: Distribution classes, manifest schema or path membership changes.

claims.statement: The fleet manifest distinguishes canonical Git targets, preset repositories and collection-only targets.
claims.proofBoundary: The declared target set is current inventory authority; filesystem discovery cannot add undeclared targets.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: Fleet schema, target membership or maintenance class changes.

claims.statement: PowerShell exposes bounded Git and WinGet timeout controls that have no forced textual Bash equivalent.
claims.sourceLocator: Hard timeout for one fetch or pull attempt.
claims.proofBoundary: Platform-specific controls preserve shared safety semantics without requiring identical parameter lists.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: Windows timeout parameters or Bash parity policy changes.

claims.statement: Enhanced, plain and headless selectors are mutually exclusive and fallback may occur only before engine start.
claims.sourceLocator: Die drei UI-Schalter sind gegenseitig ausgeschlossen
claims.proofBoundary: Fallback may reduce presentation capability but cannot change authority, blockers or engine count.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: UI selection, fallback or process-start behavior changes.

claims.statement: LocalImplementation, PublishPR and MergeAndSync grant progressively bounded delivery authority without implied secrets, provider administration or general bypass.
claims.proofBoundary: Authority is current and operation-specific; maintenance scripts still cannot publish target-repository changes.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: Autonomous delivery modes or authority boundaries change.

claims.statement: After interruption, task checkboxes, evidence and Git history outrank stale autonomous state, and an uncertain operation requires revalidation.
claims.sourceLocator: take precedence over a stale state
claims.proofBoundary: Resume reconciles completed work before retry and does not infer current remote authority.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: Autonomous resume, state precedence or revalidation policy changes.

claims.statement: A mismatched report, event or process exit yields a text next action to review all three evidence classes.
claims.proofBoundary: The reconciler identifies inconsistency but does not repair or reinterpret the underlying run.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: Result reconciliation or next-action wording changes.

claims.statement: The text-first final view exposes report, log and next action as copyable text.
claims.proofBoundary: Visible text supports accessible handoff; the underlying finalized report remains canonical.
claims.reevaluationTrigger: Final view fields, text accessibility or result authority changes.

documentationImpact.navigationImpact: Four existing reader paths gain exact links to one paired canonical guide.
documentationImpact.platformAndExampleProof: macOS/Linux Bash and Windows PowerShell examples are source-bound.
documentationImpact.reevaluationTrigger: Maintenance commands, evidence schema, reader paths or distribution classes change.
